chart.programText:
A = data('container.memory.utilized').sum(by=['aws.ecs.cluster.name']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('container.memory.usage.limit').sum(by=['aws.ecs.cluster.name']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A*1024*1024/B*100).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (100-C).publish(label='D')
